source.description: A frozen undead warrior in frost-covered dented iron armor holding an ice-sheathed longsword, standing rigid. Sways stiffly, cold white eyes pulsing, frost vapor drifting off its shoulders. Seamless loop.
The frozen warrior in rimed iron armor attacks — it heaves the ice-sheathed longsword up over its shoulder, then swings it down toward the camera in a heavy frozen arc, then stiffly resets its guard.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
